subject: Língua Inglesa
description_pt: Avaliar a própria produção escrita e a de colegas, com base no contexto de comunicação (finalidade e adequação ao público, conteúdo a ser comunicado, organização textual, legibilidade, estrutura de frases).

components.description_pt: Avaliar produção escrita quanto à adequação ao propósito comunicativo e ao público
components.description_en: Evaluate written production for appropriateness to communicative purpose and audience
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate a draft to identify the most significant areas for improvement given purpose and audience

components.description_pt: Avaliar produção escrita quanto à clareza de conteúdo e organização textual
components.description_en: Evaluate written production for content clarity and textual organization
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate and revise writing to ensure clarity and coherence across development, organization, and style

components.description_pt: Avaliar produção escrita quanto à legibilidade e estrutura de frases
components.description_en: Evaluate written production for legibility and sentence structure
components.cc_component_description: Identify how sentence structure variations affect meaning and reader interest

components.description_pt: Fornecer feedback sobre produções escritas de colegas usando critérios comunicativos estabelecidos
components.description_en: Provide feedback on peers' written production using established communicative criteria
components.cc_component_description: Revise writing by incorporating feedback from peers or adults

cc_matches.description: Vary sentence patterns for meaning, reader/listener interest, and style.
Produce clear and coherent writing in which the development, organization, and style are appropriate to task, purpose, and audience.
With some guidance and support from peers and adults, develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach.
Develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on addressing what is most significant for a specific purpose and audience.
